messages:
lena: Heads-up — Orion Health (channel partner) wants a co-sell POC for a clinical NLP assistant. they have strict requirements: EU data residency, HIPAA controls, SAML SSO, and request egress cost visibility. can someone pair on this?
sam: i can pair on infra + cost. timeline?
lena: partner wants pilot kickoff in 3 weeks, 6-week pilot, sample PHI-ish deidentified records, throughput ~30 req/s, spikes to 100/day.
jia: from platform side: we should propose Private (VPC) or Dedicated with strict retention. for HIPAA we'd need BA agreement and HSM/KMS integration.
dan: security: can we do SAML with IdP-initiated flow + SCIM? also need to confirm audit log retention and staff access controls.
emily: procurement asking for a single-line cost they can include in the SOW (pilot). can we draft Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private one-liners and list assumptions (tokens/day, bandwidth)?
sam: quick numbers for draft: Hosted pilot (with EU region): $4.5k–$7k/mo (assumes 60k tokens/day). Dedicated pilot (reserved GPUs): $10k–$14k/mo. Private/on-prem: professional services + infra estimate: $TBD (we'll give a ballpark of $20k–$40k + infra). i'll add a note about egress: mention cloud egress billed at actuals; provide estimates if they share bandwidth assumptions.
jia: infra notes: recommend 2x A10G equiv for response latency; enable KV/prefix caching for repeated clinical prompts. for Dedicated reserve a small GPU pool and autoscale.
dan: security checklist i'll start: 1) BA signed 2) AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit 3) customer-managed KMS support 4) RBAC + admin audit logs 5) SCIM/SAML + MFA enforcement 6) data retention policy (default 30d, configurable) 7) incident response playbook.
emily: procurement wording suggestion: "Redwood will deliver a 6-week pilot (Orion Health) with hosted inference in EU region. Estimated pilot cost: Hosted $5,500 (estimate), Dedicated $12,000 (estimate). Final SOW numbers subject to actual token usage and agreed BA terms." want that in single-line SOW format?
lena: yes — include the BA requirement and that numbers are estimates. also add acceptance criteria: 1) >95% accuracy on predefined extraction eval, 2) latency <600ms p95, 3) connectivity + SAML in place.
sam: partner asked about signing keys and mTLS — we support customer-managed keys + mTLS for peering. add example SAML metadata snippet to runbook.
security-bot: automated: "HIPAA readiness doc v2 created: /compliance/hipaa/orion-draft-1865" :lock:
jia: small SAML snippet i'll paste here for runbook:

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://orion-idp.example.com">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

dan: i'll assemble SOC2 artifacts and map to their questionnaire. also note: EU residency = pin to eu-central-1 region; we need to confirm log storage location too.
emily: ok owners: runbook + SAML example = jia, cost blurb = sam + emily, security questionnaire = dan, acceptance evals = lena. can we get a target to review tomorrow noon?
lena: yes. i'll schedule quick sync with Orion lead (jane@orion) at 11:30. thanks all. :thumbsup:
